acceptance: RED：目前既有測試檔沒有 contract-blocked lifecycle 與 pre-dispatch regression，命令應失敗或選不到測試。GREEN：實作後兩個 regression 證明 blocked contract、缺 dependency、baseline RED/no-op 會 fail-closed，合約完整票才可 dispatch；測試命令退出 0。
acceptance_cmd: bash -c 'set -eu; test -f ops/backlog.py; test -f ops/tests/test_backlog.py; test -f ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py; grep -qF "test_contract_blocked_lifecycle" ops/tests/test_backlog.py; grep -qF "test_pre_dispatch_refuses_missing_contract_evidence" ops/tests/test_backlog.py; uv run --no-project --python 3.13 --with pytest pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider ops/tests/test_backlog.py ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py -k "contract_blocked_lifecycle or pre_dispatch_refuses_missing_contract_evidence"'
acceptance_green_expected: Current main is expected RED because these regression nodes do not yet exist; after the contract guard lands the same command must be green.
brief: 被合約阻塞或缺少前置證據的工作仍可能進入派工，維護者會在錯誤邊界才發現。
detail: 目前 lifecycle 有 blocked_by 欄位但沒有一個形式化的 contract-blocked 判決與 pre-dispatch fail-closed 檢查，無法機械拒絕 fix_site 缺失、acceptance dependency 不存在、baseline RED 未成立或 no-op work。這會讓一張看似 groomed 的票被取走後才發現沒有可執行修法。此票只處理 repo 內 ticket lifecycle 與派工前契約，不處理 external multi_agent_v1。
fix_site: ops/backlog.py lifecycle/dispatch; ops/worktree_orchestrate.py pre-dispatch boundary; ops/tests/test_backlog.py; ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py
plan: 先定義 contract-blocked 與 pre-dispatch 的機械判準，再讓 dispatch 排除 fix_site 缺失、acceptance dependency 不存在、baseline RED 未成立或 no-op 的票；在既有 backlog 與 worktree orchestrator 測試加入 RED/GREEN，保留 blocked_by 與正常 status 語意。
scope: 一個 backlog lifecycle/pre-dispatch guard 與既有 backlog/orchestrator 測試回歸。
verified_evidence: test -f ops/backlog.py && test -f ops/tests/test_backlog.py && test -f ops/tests/test_worktree_orchestrate.py && rg -n 'blocked_by|dispatch' ops/backlog.py ops/tests/test_backlog.py
